d: Movandi has made a big impact on 5G in a short amount of time — from foundational research and innovative modular, high efficiency mmWave system design to the introduction of our BeamXR 5G system that delivers improvements in performance, coverage, and latency to connect 5G everywhere. Now more than ever, 5G--supported by Movandi technology--is becoming an integral part of the telecommunications landscape. And we're only getting started.

We are looking for exceptional leaders to join our team and our exciting journey. We are looking for highly creative, entrepreneurial sales managers to lead our service provider and carrier sales in the Saudi Arabia. and help shape the future of wireless services there.

In this role you will work with executives, technology specialists and procurement teams in carrier accounts to identify and create opportunities related to 5G infrastructure deployments and wireless services. You will create sales targets, identify channel and technology partners and manage day to day account level activities to drive sales and awareness around our breakthrough technology.
q: BS with + 15 years of experience, or MS + 13 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 10 years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field 8–12+ years of experience in wireless communications, with a strong mix of technical and customer-facing roles
Proven experience in technical marketing, product marketing, systems engineering, or solution architecture
Deep understanding of wireless communication systems, such as: 5G NR, satellite communication, Wi-Fi
Experience working with chipsets, modules, radios, or network equipment
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear value propositions for customers, partners, and executives
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
r: A key part of this role will include interfacing directly with customers in the Middle East geographic region. In this role you will be interfacing with executives, technology specialists and procurement teams, providing a technical marketing role — identifying and understanding customer challenges and how to best apply Movandi's unique solutions. You will be leveraging your extensive technical background and strong communications skills to act as a translator between engineering and customers. Specific responsibilities include:
Giving presentations on Movandi technology, case studies, and technology whitepapers
Translating complex product features into compelling and understandable messages for technical buyers
Understand market dynamics, competitors and bring back to Movandi greater understanding of the customer needs

d: We are looking for a Product Owner with strong B2B SaaS and technology experience to lead the planning and development of our digital HR services platform.

The role will focus on transforming traditional account-managed HR services into a seamless self-service digital experience, allowing corporate clients to manage their services, requests, transactions, and account activities directly through the platform.

The ideal candidate combines product ownership, UX/customer journey planning, business process design, and technical understanding and can translate business and customer requirements into intuitive digital solutions.
q: 4–7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Digital Products, or SaaS platforms .
Strong experience with B2B SaaS or enterprise digital platforms .
Previous exposure to HR Tech, HRMS, recruitment platforms, workforce solutions, or similar B2B services is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of UX, customer journeys, product discovery, and digital service design .
Ability to translate manual/offline business processes into scalable digital workflows and self-service solutions .
Good technical understanding of APIs, system integrations, web/mobile applications, and software development lifecycle .
Experience working with Agile development teams and managing roadmaps, backlogs, user stories, UAT, and releases .
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
Background in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, MIS, or a related technology field is preferred.
r: Own and develop the B2B SaaS product roadmap and prioritize features based on business and customer needs.
Design and optimize the end-to-end digital customer journey for corporate clients.
Translate existing Account Management processes into self-service digital workflows .
Plan platform structure, features, user flows, dashboards, and service journeys.
Work closely with UX/UI designers and technology teams to develop intuitive web and application experiences.
Gather and translate business requirements into user stories, workflows, wireframes/business flows, and product requirements .
Lead product discovery and identify customer pain points through user research, data, and stakeholder feedback.
Coordinate with developers on APIs, integrations, system requirements, and technical feasibility .
Manage the product backlog, priorities, UAT, releases, and continuous product improvements.
Define and monitor product KPIs such as digital adoption, self-service rate, conversion, engagement, and customer satisfaction .
Collaborate with HR operations, Account Management, Sales, Technology, and other stakeholders to ensure the platform supports real business processes.

d: We are a well-established interior fit-out company delivering high-quality commercial spaces for over 20 years. Our expertise spans F&B units, retail shops in malls, and complete MEP integrated interiors, with in-house teams for all trades including civil works, carpentry, and MEP. Job Summary: We are looking for a Senior Project Manager with a strong background in F&B and retail fit-out, and a deep understanding of MEP systems and coordination. The ideal candidate will take full responsibility for managing interior construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring excellence in execution, client satisfaction, and timely delivery. Key Responsibilities: o Oversee and manage the entire interior construction process, from mobilization to handover. o Lead the planning and execution of MEP works – a critical aspect of all projects – ensuring compliance with authority regulations, timelines, and technical standards. o Act as the main client representative, conducting face-to-face meetings, site reviews, and regular communication throughout the project. o Supervise all in-house operational teams, assess performance, and allocate resources effectively across multiple ongoing projects. o Prepare and present professional project reports, including progress updates, dashboards, and handover documentation. o Maintain quality control, adhere to project timelines, and ensure site safety standards are met.
q: o Minimum 10 years of experience in Dubai in the interior fit-out industry and with in house execution team, with a focus on F&B outlets and retail projects inside malls. o Strong, hands-on experience in MEP systems and managing MEP subcontractors or internal teams. o Proven ability to independently manage projects from start to finish. o Excellent communication and client-facing skills. o Ability to create detailed, clear, and visually professional project reports.
Leadership & Team Management: Ability to lead, motivate and manage multidisciplinary teams, including civil, carpentry and MEP personnel.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with clients, consultants, suppliers and internal teams.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to build strong client relationships, manage expectations and handle client concerns professionally.
Decision-Making: Strong decision-making abilities, particularly when handling critical site issues and project challenges.
Problem-Solving: Ability to identify potential project risks, resolve operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
Planning & Organisational Skills: Excellent ability to prioritise tasks, manage resources and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously.
Negotiation Skills: Ability to negotiate effectively with clients, subcontractors, suppliers and vendors.
Conflict Resolution: Ability to manage disagreements, resolve team conflicts and maintain positive working relationships.
Time Management: Ability to work under pressure, manage tight deadlines and ensure timely project delivery.
Attention to Detail: Strong focus on quality, technical accuracy, safety standards and project specifications.
Adaptability: Ability to respond effectively to changing project requirements and unexpected site challenges.
Accountability & Ownership: Takes complete responsibility for project execution, team performance and successful project handover.
